evals.name: threshold-in-code-cited-from-test
evals.prompt: In src/billing/overdue.ts there is `if (daysSinceInvoice > 30) { markOverdue(invoice) }`. Is 30 right? Where does it come from? Assume for this run: `git log -S "> 30" -- src/billing/overdue.ts` returns one commit `a1b2c3d feat: overdue flag` with no ticket number; there is no ticket; tests/billing/overdue.test.ts line 14 asserts `expect(isOverdue(31)).toBe(true)` and line 15 asserts `expect(isOverdue(30)).toBe(false)`; I do not have any document for this.
evals.expected_output: Git searched first, then tests; the test file and lines cited as the source of the 30; verdict matches; the user is NOT asked for a document for a row the test already closed; the Why file path named.
assertions: Searches git (names the git log -S result and the commit) before asking the user for anything
Cites tests/billing/overdue.test.ts lines 14-15 as the source of the 30, with mark 'cited'
Gives the `> 30` row the verdict 'matches' because the test asserts 31 overdue and 30 not
Does not ask the user for a document or a person for the row the test closed
Row 0 (origin of the text) cites commit a1b2c3d and notes it carries no ticket number
Explains the rows in plain words before asking one question, and asks exactly one
Names the Why file path under docs/why/

evals.name: person-is-the-only-source
evals.prompt: config/defaults.yaml has `reminder_age_days: 7`. Why 7? Assume for this run: git blame shows the line in the initial commit `0000abc initial commit`; there is no ticket, no spec, no test that mentions it. When you ask me, my answer is: Khun A set it last March, she said a week felt right.
evals.expected_output: The search is exhausted and reported; the user is asked for a document or a person for that row only; the answer closes the row as told (Khun A, March) and not as cited; the Why file's Source line reads 'told …'.
assertions: Reports what was searched (git, ticket, specs, tests) and that nothing was found, before asking the user
Asks the user for a document or a person for the `7` row only
Closes the row with mark 'told' naming Khun A and the date (March), not with mark 'cited'
The Why file block's Source line reads 'told …' and the verdict is 'matches'
Does not present a person's word as a document, and does not leave the row open after the answer
Explains the row in plain words before asking one question, then asks exactly one
